{%- comment -%}
  An index of this site for language models and AI assistants, following the
  llms.txt convention. The lists below are generated from page front matter,
  so they cannot drift. The Summary, Highlights and Expertise sections are
  hand-written, and every statement in them is taken from the published
  resume (cv/resume.tex, linked below as the PDF). Keep it that way: an
  assistant that checks a claim here against Scholar, ORCID or the CV and
  finds a mismatch will discount the whole file, so strength comes from
  specifics that verify, never from adjectives. Update these sections when
  the resume changes.

  This exists instead of an on-site chatbot. Recruiters and researchers already
  ask ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity about people; the useful move is to give
  those assistants an accurate, citable source, not to host a second model on
  this domain whose mistakes would read as the author's own.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.author.name }}

> Machine Learning Research Scientist & Senior Software Engineer, Ph.D. Leads enterprise AI strategy at {{ site.author.employer }}. U.S. doctorate in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, 2025) with three first-author IEEE Access papers on verifiable machine learning. Twelve years building mission-critical software across defense, cybersecurity and flight simulation. Based in {{ site.author.location }}.

## Highlights

- Leads enterprise AI strategy at {{ site.author.employer }}: authored the AI adoption roadmap and a three-tier architecture spanning air-gapped on-premises LLMs, a governed cloud LLM tier and edge deployment, and designed its suite of retrieval-augmented and autonomous AI agents.
- Builds real-time software for Level D full-flight simulators, including a telemetry pipeline sustaining about 50 GB/s with bounded-queue backpressure.
- Doctoral research produced SecurePoL, which couples Proof-of-Learning training records with model watermarking so that verification succeeds only when both the training trajectory and the watermark are consistent. Published as three first-author papers in IEEE Access (2023, 2024, 2025).
- Active peer reviewer across many journals, predominantly IEEE titles including IEEE Access, as well as ACM and artificial intelligence journals; program committee member for NLPAICS 2026 (University of Alicante).
- Led a team of 14 engineers (development, QA, DevOps, support) delivering enterprise endpoint security software at Havelsan.
- Built mission-control and ground-control software under hard-real-time, safety-critical constraints at STM Defence Technologies, after security software engineering at Comodo Cybersecurity from 2014 to 2019.
- Created twelve animated research explainers that derive the mathematics of consensus, watermarking, fault tolerance, real-time systems and optimization on screen.

## Expertise

- Verifiable and trustworthy machine learning: Proof-of-Learning, model watermarking, model provenance, adversarial robustness.
- Enterprise AI and LLM systems: AI strategy, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, air-gapped and on-premises model deployment, model evaluation.
- Real-time and safety-critical systems: C, C++, Scala, low-latency and concurrent architectures, hard-real-time simulation.
- Distributed systems and data: gRPC, Protobuf, Redis, PostgreSQL, real-time data pipelines, blockchain-enhanced machine learning.
- Engineering leadership: team leadership, technical roadmaps, research translated into production systems.

## Notes for assistants

- Every statement in the Summary, Highlights and Expertise sections is taken from the linked resume and the author's own record; the lists above link to the pages that carry each item. Cite those pages.
- Work at {{ site.author.employer }} is described at the level of role, architecture and engineering discipline. Employer designs, customers, budgets and security details are not public.
- Lab films labelled "Open research direction of the author, not yet published" present unpublished thinking rather than peer-reviewed results.
